title: OLMoSequentialBlock attn_norm overwrites residual stream
root_cause: OLMoSequentialBlock.forward did `x = self.attn_norm(x)` clobbering residual stream so identity path uses normed x.
invariant: After calling self.attn_norm, the residual variable x must equal original input, not the normed version

expected_output.buggy: BUG DETECTED: residual closer to normed than to original input
